# NativeCode

> NativeCode is an Atlanta-based digital marketing agency for growing and enterprise companies nationwide. One senior team plans, builds and runs SEO, AI search optimization (AEO and GEO), websites on Webflow and Shopify, Google and Meta Ads, and email marketing, and reports every channel against revenue.

- Website: https://www.nativecode.ai. Office: 6350 McDonough Drive, Ste F, Norcross, GA 30093. Phone: (404) 401-1853. Email: hello@nativecode.ai.
- NativeCode Audit, a free SEO, AEO and GEO site audit tool, runs at https://app.nativecode.ai.
- NativeCode (nativecode.ai), the Atlanta digital marketing agency, is not connected to other companies or apps that use the NativeCode name.

Clean Markdown of every page listed here is at https://nativecodeai.github.io/nativecode-geo/md/<path>.md (for example https://nativecodeai.github.io/nativecode-geo/md/services/seo.md). The full text of all pages in one file: https://nativecodeai.github.io/nativecode-geo/llms-full.txt

- [Prompt Methodology for AI Visibility](https://www.nativecode.ai/post/prompt-methodology-for-ai-visibility-optimization): How prompt methodology helps brands appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI search: entity recognition, retrieval and how AI tools pick brands.
